(nga )༄༅/ /dge ba can ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi lugs gtsang la ma 'dres pa bdud rtsi'i za ma tog ces bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// dge ba can ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi lugs gtsang la ma 'dres pa bdud rtsi'i za ma tog ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru ār+yā tā rā yai/ ga bur nying khus byugs pa'i mtshan dpe ni// bdud rtsi'i zer brgya 'dzag pas 'jig rten gyi// ring por 'tsho ba'i chu gter ji snyed spel// snying gi dpyid du bla ma'i ngo bor bsti// gang las brgyud pa'i bla ma thugs rje can// lam srol 'di las grub gnyis gter gyi mdzod// rang gis spyod cing gzhan la sbyin mdzad pa// de dag zhabs la yan lag mchog gis btud// srol mang bdud rtsi snying la sems mod kyi// nus bcud khyad 'phags rang srol jo bo'i lugs// karma kaṃ tshang rje btsun jo nang pa'i// gdams ngag chu bo gcig tu bsdus nas 'chad// de la slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ chos spyod dbang po dul ba ni// 'khor ba ru ni ji srid 'tsho// de srid bsod nams la sogs tshogs// byang chub sgrub byed rab tu skye// 'khor bar srog las gces pa ni// ci yang yod pa ma mthong ste// de bas myur du thabs mang pos// 'chi ba slu ba kun tu spyad// gang phyir rig pas thabs sbyar bas// dka' ba cung zad yod pa yin// ces gsungs pa ltar/ byang chub sgrub pa'i rten mchog lha las lhag pa 'di nyid ring por 'tsho ba'i thabs la thog ma nyid du sgo thams cad nas 'bad par rigs shing*/ de lta bu'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig ston pa thugs rje can de'i ring lugs las 'byung ba las/ rdzas sman rten 'brel tshogs bsags sogs phyi'i bya ba las khyad par du 'phags shing*/ nang gi rnal 'byor la brten pa rnams kyi rab dang phul du gyur pa/ gnas skabs brgyad dang bcu drug sogs byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs dang bar chad 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob cing*/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang*/ mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub dus thung ngus bde blag tu 'thob par byed pa/

sngags bla med ma rgyud rigs drug gi nang tshan dpal rta'i rgyal po'i rigs sgrol ma mngon 'byung sogs las gsal bar gsungs pa'i rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i chu srol/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bzhi dang lnga dang drug sogs su babs pa las/ sku tshe'i dngos grub dang phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes te grub gnyis bar ma chad du brnyes pas/ yid ches myong rtags can gyi brgyud srol khyad par du 'phags pa/ 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa dang mgon po gser gling pa'i rjes 'brang dpal ldan mar me mdzad dang*/ rgyal ba gnyis pa dge slong 'tsho byed las rim par brgyud/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal karma pa yab sras kyi thugs dam las byon pa dang*/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang sgrol ba'i mgon po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi gung spros te dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal sgo las ji tsam thob pa nor bu'i snying po lta bu'i zab mo'i gdams ngag bslad med rkang tshugs 'chad par byed pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ thun mong sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor/ thun min tshogs bsags gnyis so// dang po la bzhi/ rgyud dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ lam log pa dang dman pa las khyad par du byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid do// dang po ni/ tho rangs bya rog gi skad ma grag gong du langs la khrus gtsang ma bya/ stan bde bar sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 'khod la sdig sgrib dang tshe'i bar chad bsal bar mos la rlung ro lan gsum bsal/ rang tha mal par gnas pa'i spyi gtsug tu pad zla'i gdan la bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/

mtshan dpe dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng mu tig rdog ma ltar 'khod pa/ rang gi snying gar pad zla'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das ma thugs kar tām̐ yig dang bcas pa bla ma dang dbyer med pa'ang bzhugs par bsams la/ nyes byas la 'gyod sems dang bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa la mos gus drag pos/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa kye// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig chag nyams thams cad mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mi sbed do// byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma rdor sems zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas 'od du zhu spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ snying ga'i sgrol ma dkar mo la thim/ bzlas pa dang mos gus kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar po'i rgyun byung*/ sku yi nang gang*/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi srin lag rtse nas bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun ltar babs/ rang gi lus kyi nang gang*/ sdig sgrib nad gdon dus dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba dam tshig nyams chag thams cad sbun pa chus dad pa ltar ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon/ lus phyi nang sgrib pa med pa shel gong lta bu dag cing dkar gsal du gyur snyam du bsams la/ yi ge bcu pa dang rdor sems yig brgya sbrel ba ci nus bzlas la mthar/ de ltar 'dod don gsol 'debs bshags sbyang sogs byas pas bcom ldan 'das ma 'od du zhu/ rang nyid la thim pas/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma dngos su gyur snyam du bsams la 'khor gsum mi rtog pa chos nyid kyi ngang du bzhag 'di kho nar thun du bcad pa yin na mthar dge ba bsngo ba'ang bya dgos te 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre'o// rgyun gyi nyams len lta bur bsdus par spro na/

rang tha mal pa'i snying gar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig dkar po'i mthar yig brgya mu tig gi phreng ba lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer zla ba lta bu byung*/ lus gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib las dang rnam smin sha khrag gi phung po dang bcas pa sbyangs te lus 'od kyi rang bzhin tu gyur par mos la/ yig bcu dang yig brgya bzlas mthar/ lha mo bdag ni/ dam tshig las ni/ bla ma sgrol mas/ sogs gong ltar gsol ba btab pas/ yi ge gdan bcas 'od du zhu/ rang nyid la thim pas sbyang bya gdod ma nas ma dmigs pa'i chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'o// zhes mnyam par bzhag 'di khrid rim spyi dang bstun na skyabs sems kyi rjes su byed pa yin cing mtha' gcig tu khrigs chags mi dgos kyang yig rnying lugs srol sor bzhag pa'o// dper na snod ma dag pa la zas sogs blugs na chud 'dza' ba ltar/ sgrib pa can la lam gyi mngon rtogs mi skye bas thog mar snod kyi sgrib pa nyes ltung sbyangs na rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin skye ba la dka' tshegs med pas/ thog mar 'di bsgom pa ni snod bkru bshal byed pa'i tshab yin pas gal shin tu che'o// gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma'i sdong po yal ga lo 'bras phun sum tshogs shing 'dab ma bzhir byas pa'i dbus su/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rje btsun ma dbyer med pa la rnam pa mgon po 'od dpag med bla ma kun 'dus kyi skur bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi 'dab ma la 'phags ma sgrol ma yi dam kun 'dus/ g.yas su shākya'i dbang po sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ rgyab tu yum chen mo nyid dam chos dkon mchog thams cad kyi ngo bo/ g.yon tu spyan ras gzigs dge 'dun kun 'dus/ khor yug dang bar mtshams su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sprin gtibs pa ltar zhugs par mos/ spro na mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ dkyus la mi dgos/ rang gis gtsor byas ma rgan sems can thams cad khrom tshogs su 'khod par bsam/

de rnams kyis sdug bsngal myong tshul la bsam/ sdug bsngal de dag las khyed rnams kyis skyob par mdzad du gsol snyam du sems thag pa nas bsams la rang gis 'dren dpon byas pas sems can thams cad kyis kyang sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro di ri ri byed par mos la/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs grangs ji ltar rigs pa gsag sems bskyed pa ni/ nam mkhas khyab tshad kyi sems can thams cad dmigs yul du byas te/ 'di rnams kyis thog ma med pa nas bdag gi pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho bzod dka' ba la gtan tu thar dus med par 'khyams pa snying re rje/ 'di rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa 'chi med rtag pa dam pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya snyam pa'i dam bca' dang 'brel ba smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de'i ched du gnas skabs su tshe ring ba/ nad med pa/ bar chad zhi ba/ khyad par bla ma'i sku tshe brtan cing sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba/ mthar thug dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum gyur 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang dus myur ba nyid du bde blag tu 'thob par bya ba'i phyir rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs la 'jug cing brtson pa chen pos mthar dbyung ste/ yi dam 'di nyid ma 'grub bar du srog la babs kyang mi gtong snyam pa dam bca' de'i rjes sgrub la zhugs pa 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems legs par bskyed de/ dag tu byang mchis ma sogs tshigs bcad rgyas pa'am/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu sogs lan kha yar brjod/ mthar skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ba bla ma la thim/ de'ang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas dkon mchog bla ma'i byin rlabs bdag rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ 'di bsgrubs pas yon tan dang dngos grub thams cad 'byung nges snyam du yid ches dang dad pa'i rgyun ma bral na don thams cad myur du 'grub pa'i gdams ngag yang dag pa'o//
//gsum pa ni/ thog mar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyang*/

bsang chus bran pa sogs mi dgos/ hūm̐ zhes pas bar chad srung bar mos la spro na 'bru'i tshom bu chung ngu zhig dor/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mī āḥhūm̐/ gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du ri rab lhun po gling bzhi gling phran mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i ri gling rnams la pad zla'i gdan dang bcas pa grub par bsam/ ba byung lnga dang dri bzang gi chus byugs la/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ bar mtshams thams cad yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i spos chus gang zhing phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba/ dbus kyi gdan la tām̐/ phyogs gzhir tām̐ mum̐ a hrīḥrnams gsal bar mos/ rang nyid yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du trām̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkha' steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ 'og gi cha la rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgya dang bcas spyan drang*/ 'phags yul ba'i lugs ltar na me tog gsar pa'am/ ma rnyed na bod kyi lag len ltar 'bru'i tshom bu dbus dang phyogs bzhir bkod pa dang mnyam du/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa rnams gdan gyi sa bon la thim ste yongs su gyur pa/ ri rab kyi steng du bla ma sgrol ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ shar lus 'phags por sgrol ma brgya rtsa la yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug lho dzam+bu'i gling du shākya thub pa la dus gsum sangs rgyas/ nub ba lang spyod du yum chen mo la dam chos glegs bam gyi rnam pa/ byang sgra mi snyan tu spyan ras gzigs la theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/ mtshams rnams su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad sprin gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos la maṇ+ḍal de nyid mdun gyi stegs bu mthon por bzhag

'byor du rung na phyi mchod dngos su bsham mo// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas bla ma la phyag byas par mos te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes dang*/ yi dam 'khor bcas la dmigs te/ na ma ār+yā tā ra sogs dang*/ gang drin ma sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyang brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer las sprul pa'i lha mo rgyan dang rnam 'gyur mtshar sdug phul du byung ba mang pos so sor mchod par mos/ ar+ghaṃ sogs sngags dmigs phyag rgya rim par sbyar te/ mchod pa'i lha mo dkar mo rnams kyis gser dang bai ḍūr+ya'i bya ma bum nas yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu'i ar+ghaṃ sbreng ba dang*/ lha mo dmar mos bdud rtsi lnga dang shun pa lnga sogs 'dag chal dang ldan pas chu gtsang gis zhabs bsil ba dang*/ lha mo dkar mos chu skyes thang skyes yid byung gi me tog lta na sdug pa dbu la 'thor ba dang*/ lha mo dud kas rang byung dang sbyar ba'i bdug spos dri bsung can shangs la 'bul ba dang*/ lha mo dmar skyas rin chen nyi zla sgron me'i rigs gyur phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten lham mer byed pa spyan lam du bstar ba dang*/ lha mo ljang gus ga bur gur gum tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dri'i chab dung phor nas blangs te thugs ka la sogs pa'i sku'i gnas rnams su 'thor ba dang byugs pa dang thig le byed pa dang*/ lha mo dmar mos sbyar ba dang yongs su gyur pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i lha mi'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa ljags la 'bul ba dang*/ lha mo sngon mos sil snyan gling bu pi waṃ rnga zlum sogs lha'i rol mo'i rigs gyur snyan lam du 'khrol bas tshogs zhing rnams zag med bde bas dgyes/ lha mo rnams rang thugs sa bon la thim par bsam/ de dag gi don bskyar nas gsal 'debs pa dang*/ yan lag lhag ma rnams rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ma sogs brjod bzhin tu/ mchod pa gzhan yang lus longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po mtha' dag kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du sprul nas ltos pa med par 'bul/

bdag gzhan rnams kyi bcas dang rang bzhin gyis kha na ma tho bas mtshon sdig pa sngar byas pa thams cad gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags shing*/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyi zhing sdom par dam bca'/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi khongs su rnam byang dang mthun pa'i chos kyi yon tan dang dge ba ci mchis pa thams cad la snying thag pa nas dga' zhing spro bas rjes su yi rang*/ ji ltar tshangs pa chen pos bcom ldan 'das la yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pa ltar theg mchog bla na med pa'i chos 'khor dus rgyun chad med par bskor ba bskul/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bla ma rje btsun ma'i sku'i rnam pa'i tshul 'di kho na nub pa med par rtag brtan ther zug tu bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ dus gsum gyi dge rtsa thams cad rgyal ba'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rang bzhin rje btsun sgrol ma'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i phyir du bsngo/ de dag gi dge bas tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo dang mi 'bral zhing rjes su bzung nas byang chub spyod pa rgya mtsho mthar phyin pa smon no// de nas tshogs zhing gi lha la sems gtad nas yi ge bcu pa dang spel tshig can ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ de nas mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal rdul phyi/ rin po che'am dri bzang gi chus brlan pa'i tshom bu bkod la/ spyi mthun so bdun ma 'bul yang rung mod/ rje dgu pa'i bzhed pa ltar na/ mdun bskyed skabs su bshad pa'i tshom bu lnga ma dang zhing khams rnam dag sogs kyis grangs bzung*/ mthar dpag bsam gyi ni sogs mchod pa sna tshogs pa'ang 'bul zhing*/ phyi ri rab gling bzhi'i rnam pa/ nang rang gi phung khams dang dbyer med cing*/ gzhan rigs lnga'i zhing gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i ri rab la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag rgyan bkod pa tshad med pa dang ldan pa nyid/ de kho na nyid 'od gsal rang snang gi longs spyod du dbul bas dgyes pa'i phul du son par bsams la/

bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs kyis 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu bsdus nas mgo bor bzhag pa dang mnyam du/ tshogs zhing rnams 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te thim pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu'i sku dang dbyer med du gyur pa mos/ 'dir yang spro na spyan 'dren gdan 'bul phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa rnams kyi tshigs bcad rgyas pa sbyor ba yin cing tshul de dang de rigs rje dgu pa'i sgrol dkar chen mor gsal/ 'dir tshe khrid rkang tshugs 'chad cing thun so sor nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel pa'am/ ma 'brel yang spros pas mi lcogs na sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bsgrub bskyed kyi bya ba gang yang mi dgos shing*/ sgrub thabs dkyus su bstan pa ltar tshogs zhing nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la yan lag bdun pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing*/ spros pa shin tu chung bar byed na/ de ka'i mur gsol 'debs dbang len bgyis pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang 'grub pa yin no// //bzhi pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog dkar mo ston zla'i 'od dang mtshungs pa/ rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal bar mos/ yig 'bru de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog rnams re re nas spyan drangs/ bla ma la thim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus su gyur/ mdor na dkon mchog rgya mtsho dngos// mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub kun// dran pa tsam gyis stsol mdzad pa// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'o// zhes nges pa'i shes pa bskyed/ 'dir yang spro na mchod bstod bya bar gsungs/

de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zur du gsal ba ltar tshar gcig gi rjes/ khrid kyi skabs 'dir pad+ma nyin byed rje karma theg mchog bstan 'phel nges par 'dzud dgos/ gsol 'debs kyi bsnyen pa bya bar spro na 'dir dmigs bsal ma gsungs kyang bka' brgyud rin po che spyi'i phyag bzhes bzhin ma nam bzhi skor la grangs bzung*/ dkyus su bstan pa ni skyabs bdun ma ste/ gnas skye ba med pa'i sogs tshar ji tsam 'os pa dang mos kyi gdung shugs drag po dang ldan pas brjod mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ lam dus kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du len pa ni/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma tha mi dad pa'i dpral ba nas sku'i bdud rtsi dang 'od zer dkar po/ mgrin pa las gsung gi bdud rtsi dang 'od zer dmar po/ thugs ka nas thugs kyi bdud rtsi dang 'od zer sngon po/ lte ba nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang 'od zer ser po byon te rang gi gnas bzhir zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ sgrib pa bzhi dag dbang bzhi thob/ sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can tu byas/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur pa mos la gnyug ma'i rang ngor mnyam par bzhag go /gal te nyams len bsdus pa'i dbang du byed na/ gong smos tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ phyag mchod sogs dang maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i rjes su/ tshogs zhing gi 'khor thams cad gtso mo la thim/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma tha dad med pa de nyid rang gi spyi bor byon te pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ ces mos la gsol 'debs sogs byas pa'i rjes su bla ma bcom ldan 'das ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas bla ma'i gsang ba gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum gnyis su med par gyur pa mos pa tsam gyis dbang bzhi don gyis tshang ngo*//

//gnyis pa la gnyis/ kun rdzob bsod nams dang*/ don dam ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// spyir gong du smos pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi bya ba la sogs pa de rnams kyang tshogs bsags pa yin mod kyi/ de dag ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che skye ba'i thabs su gyur pa yin la/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa la med na mi 'byung gi rgyu'i rkyen byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis yin pas 'dir dmigs su phye nas ston pa ste/ dang po ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i pha ma sems can thams cad 'phral dang yun tu bde ba dang ldan par ma zad/ de'i rgyu dge ba phun sum tshogs pa la ngang gis spyod par gyur cig snyam pa byams pa tshad med/ des 'gres te/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rgyur bcas spong ba la ngang gis 'jug par gyur cig snyam pa snying rje tshad med/ gnas skabs ltar snang gi bde ba tsam ma yin par sdug bsngal dang gtan du bral ba'i bde ba dam pa las nam yang mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba tshad med/ thams cad kyang dgra gnyen sogs nye ring phyogs lhung chags sdang gi 'du shes dang bral nas gru gcig pa'i nang gi mgron po ltar mnyam pa chen po'i sems thob par gyur cig snyam pa btang snyoms tshad med pa bzhi'i don nan tan tu dran bzhin tu/ ngag 'don dal bar brjod/ 'di tsam bsgoms pas tshangs ris kyi gnas su skye bar byed cing*/ de'i steng du thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems dang 'bral bas mthar thug gi tshangs pa chen po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas tshangs gnas bzhi'am/ sems can re re tsam dang dus nyi tshe ba ma yin par mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad gtan gyi bde ba la 'god pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa la zhugs pas tshad med bzhi zhes kyang bya'o// //gnyis pa ni/ gtan tshigs chen po bzhi la sogs pas dpyad mthar stong par 'jog pa ni skabs 'di dag tu mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ma yin la/

rnam par mi rtog pa'i mnyam gzhag ni nges par dgos te/ de'ang gshis cir yang ma grub pa tsam gyi stong nyid dang*/ ma grub pa de kun rdzob sems snang tsam dang sbrel ba'i rig pa sgyu ma lta bu la zung 'jug tu btags pa tsam ma yin pa/ stong nyid rnam grangs thams cad kyi mchog spros bral gyi rig pa don dam rnam pa thams cad pa la mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ de nyid las dang po pas rgyas 'debs dang*/ gnas lugs rtogs pa rnams kyi rang ngor 'jog pa tshig gis gsal 'debs pa'i phyir/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags brjod/ sngags don ni/ shū n+ya tā stong nyid de/ sems las gzhan pa phyi snod nang lus sogs gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos rnams med/ rnam rig tsam gyi sems de'ang rang gi ngo bos ma grub ste gdod nas stong pa'o// dz+nyā na ye shes te/ 'on kyang bem stong nam mkha' lta bu ma yin pa/ don dam pa'i rig pa rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba'o// badz+ra ni rdo rje ste de nyid rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung gi rang bzhin tu gang gsungs pa de'o// swa bhā ba rang bzhin te ye shes rdo rje de nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs sam rang bzhin tu yod pa'o// āt+ma ka bdag nyid de gnas lugs su bden pas don dam pa'i bdag nyid do// a haṃ nga'o zhes pa ste rang gi sems kyi rang bzhin de ltar yin pa la yin par shes pa'i nga rgyal bzung ba'o// stong pa nyid ces pas kun rdzob spros pa'i mtha' spangs la/ ye shes sogs kyis don dam ye shes rdo rje bstan pa'i don go bar byas te gshis lugs kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go/ //gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim mo// dang po la gnyis/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la'ang gsum/ yan lag bzhi ldan gyis lha'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa/ mchod bstod/ gsal brtan dag dran la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ stong pa nyid de'i ngang las/

mtshan rtog gis ma bcos pa'i sems nyid gnyug ma'i snang cha/ hūm̐ zhes pa'i sgra gdangs nam mkha' gang bar sad pa'i rkyen gyis/ 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de la brtan pa'i logs rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur rdo rje'i tog dang bcas pa/ rwa gur gyi nang mtshams su rdo rje'i bla bre/ phyi ngos su rdo rje'i drwa ba dpyangs pa/ gur khang de la ltong zub cing rdo rje'i mde'u phyi rol du bstan pa'i mda'i drwa ba bsnol ma/ thams cad kyang kha dog dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ bgegs dang log 'dren lta ci smos bskal pa'i me rlung gis kyang gzhig mi nus pa/ de'i dbus su rnam snang sa bon yi ge bh+rūm̐ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che zla shel te nor bu chu shel 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas shing rgyan dang mchod pa'i bye brag rnam pa mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su pam̐ yig dkar po las chu skyes kyi bye brag pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma dang lo 'dab rab tu rgyas shing rin po che'i sdong bu sra zhing mkhregs la ge sar dang bcas pa'i steng du/ a dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang zhing rnyogs pa'i dri ma dang bral ba/ gdan de dag gi steng du sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang gis rang gi sems nyid tām̐ yig kha dog dkar po ring cha zla tshes thig le dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ut+pal dkar po lo 'dab sdong bu dang bcas pa tām̐ dkar pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer gyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad du thogs pa med par 'phros/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba la sogs pa 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug bsal/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer de dag tshur 'dus ut+pal dang tām̐ yig la thim/

de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs mngon rtogs ltar shar bsgom du bya zhing*/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can du gyur/ ces sku yongs rdzogs gsal 'debs pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i cha smad du hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ thugs ka'i dbus su pad dkar dang zla ba la tām̐ yig dkar po 'od zer dang bcas pa gsal bar bsgoms pa ni nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag de las 'od zer 'phros/ chos kyi dbyings dang po ta la la sogs pa nas ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdang*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa la/ sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas rang dam tshig pa la thim ste gnyis su med par gyur/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du nam yang mi gshegs par bsams pa sgrub pa'i yan lag slar rang thugs sa bon tām̐ gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga sems dpa' khro bo yab yum rnams spyan drangs/ gong bzhin mchod pas mchod/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems mas mchod cing shis pa brjod/ khro bo khro mos bgegs bskrad/ yum lngas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba thogs te sngags dang tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing dbang bskur bas/ bum pa'i chus lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can dmar po mnyam gzhag lhung bzed bsnams pas dbur brgyan/ dbang lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par bsams pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /gnyis pa ni/ 'phrul dga'i lha'i spyod yul ltar rang las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rang nyid la mchod pa'i bye brag gong du smos pa lta bus mchod cing*/

dbyangs kyi yan lag brgya dang ldan pas bstod par mos la mthar lha mo rnams kyang rang la bsdu'o// //gsum pa la gsum/ lha snang gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ rnam dag dran pa la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis lha bskyed cing mchod bstod bcas zin nas gsal snang la rtse gcig tu bslab dgos shing*/ 'di ni rim pa dang po'i dngos gzhi yin la sngags bzlas tsam ni de'i yan lag nyid do// de'ang las dang po pas rim par gsal 'debs la/ gsal snang cung zad thob nas gcig char gsal 'debs/ des na thog mar sku'i cha shas re re nas gsal 'debs pa ste/ sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba dkar zhing nor bu chu shel ltar dwangs la lta bas mi bzod pa'i 'od zer lnga ldan ring du 'phro ba/ spyan dkyus dang snyan shal ring zhing spyan dkar nag phyed pa la ba mchog lta bu'i rdzi ma dang cung zad 'khyog pa'i smin mas mdzes pa/ shangs dang zhal nas ut+pa la'i dri bsung 'thul zhing mchu sgros gtsang la dmar ba/ tshems phreng bzhi bcu thags bzang zhing ljags srab cing mnyen pa/ bung ba'am tong zil ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra li ba ltag pa'i gnas su bcings shing lhag ma ral pa'i zar bu g.yas g.yon tu 'phyangs pa/ ri mo gsum dang ldan pa'i mgrin pa zlum pa/ phyag sor rnams pad snal ltar phra zhing mnyen pa sogs mtshar sdug phul du byung ba/ lta bas mi ngoms pa'i sgeg pa'i nyams mthong ba tsam gyis zag med kyi bde ba sbyin pa/ mkhrang shing zlum pa'i nu 'bur zung dang rked skabs phra zhing smad kyi zhing rgyas la gsang ba'i pad+ma ru sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho ba sogs gzhon nu ma lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ltar 'dzum zhing chags pa'i nyams kyis 'jig rten gsum gyi brtan pa 'phrog pa/ dpral ba'i ngos dang bcas pa'i dbu la spyan gsum/ phyag zhabs bzhi'i mthil du spyan re re ste/ bsdams pas rnam par bkra shing 'dzum pa'i ye shes kyi spyan bdun dang ldan pa/

phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo'i steng du brkyangs pa/ g.yon pa thugs kar mtheb srin sbyar zhing lhag ma bsgrengs pas lo ma dang kha dog dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa'i ut+pal dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ mu tig dkar po gtso bor gyur pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa las byas pa'i rgyan brgyad kyis spras pa ste/ de'ang skra mtshams su gser gyi pad+ma kha bye ba'i phreng ba la gnas pa'i lha mi'i nor bu 'od zer ring du 'phro bas dbu brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rna skor zlum po nor bu'i phra tshom can gyi snyan rgyan/ mgrin pa mdzes pa'i mgul rgyan/ de las ring ba nu ma'i thad du slebs pa'i se mo do/ lte ba'i 'og yan 'khor ba'i do shal/ dpung pa dang mkhrig ma gnyis la che chung tsam las dbyibs gcig pa'i phyag gdub/ long bu'i gnas su dkris pa'i zhabs gdub ste thams cad kyang rin po che'i gzhung gsum sogs ji ltar mdzes pa rin po che'i phreng ba gsum gshibs la sogs pas spel zhing nor bu'i chun 'phyang phra mo du mas spras pa/ gser gyi ske rags nor bu'i phra ldan la brten pa'i 'og lpags rin po che'i drwa ba dang chun 'phyang rnams kyi sner dngul gyi g.yer kha 'khrol ba/ dar dkar gser gyi ri mo can gyi stod g.yogs/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i dar sna tshogs pa'i sham thabs dang mthing shun gyi mdog can gyi 'og lpags te ring thung rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa lha'i me tog tshar du dngar ba du mas sku'i stod smad thams cad du 'phyor sgeg tu spras pa/ pad zla'i gdan la zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas shing sku drang por bsrangs te bzhugs pa dwangs shing rnyogs pa dang bral ba bsil zer ring du 'phro ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pa la rgyab brten pa/ spyi bo'i rigs bdag gnas gsum 'bru gsum/ thugs ka'i yid bzhin 'khor lo/

gdan pad zla/ chu shel gyi gzhal yas khang*/ phyi rol srung ba'i 'khor lo'i bar du nang nas phyir rim pa bzhin gsal 'debs shing sems 'dzin/ res srung 'khor/ gzhal yas khang*/ gdan/ sku'i rnam pa sogs phyi nas nang du gsal 'debs/ khyad par cha shas sam rnam pa gang gsal ba la sems rtse gcig bzung bas/ des gsal snang mched pa na rnam pa spyi la bslab cing*/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan/ gsal la ma 'dres pa dbang po'i gzhu/ kun la khyab pa chu zla lta bur yun ring du bsgoms pas/ tha ma yid yul du gsal ba/ 'bring mngon sum dang mtshungs pa/ rab de las kyang gsal zhing brtan par gyur na ji skad bshad pa'i las dang dngos grub thogs pa med par 'grub pa yin no// //gnyis pa ni/ sku'i rnam pa gsal rung mi gsal rung*/ rang tha mal du 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dor te rgyal ba sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rang bzhin rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos yin no// de'i sku gsung thugs yon tan mdzad pa phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la yod do snyam pa'i nga rgyal thun dang thun mtshams thams cad du rgyun bskyangs pas byin rlabs ma lus pa 'di las byung ngo*// //gsum pa ni/ lha'i sku de'ang tha mal pa'i lus 'dus shing dngos por grub pa can lta bu ma yin pa/ 'bras chos kyi yon tan thams cad gzugs kyi rnam par ston pa ste/ sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa spangs pas sku mdog dkar mo/ ye shes lnga'i rang rtsal phyogs med du 'char bas rang 'od lnga ldan 'phro ba/ de bzhin nyid ro gcig pa'i zhal/ bden gnyis zung 'jug gi phyag srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i zhabs/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi chos nyid ji lta bar gzigs shing*/ tshad med pa bzhis chos can ji snyed pa la thugs rje 'jug pa'i spyan bdun/ phyag g.yas grub pa gnyis kyi mchog sbyin pa/ phyag g.yon mtheb srin sbyar bas thabs shes zung 'jug

lhag ma bsgrengs pas dkon mchog gsum mtshon cing*/ spang bya'i sbubs grol zhing rtogs bya'i yon tan rab tu rgyas pas ut+pal dkar po bsnams pa/ spros mtha' thams cad chos kyi dbyings su bsdams pas dbu skra gcig tu bcings pa/ rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum du gyur cing 'gro ba thugs rjes mi gtong bas sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can/ yon tan dang mdzad pa mtha' yas pa mnga' bas dar dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yo bas sku drang por bzhugs pa/ nyon mongs pas mi phyed pas rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas pa/ 'od dpag med pas rang rigs mtshon cing zag med bde ba rgyas pas zla ba la rgyab brten pa/ don dam byang chub kyi sems cha gang bas zla ba dang*/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyis 'khor bar 'jug kyang 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas pad+ma dkar po ste/ byang sems gnyis la rtag tu gnas pas gdan gyi rnam par shar ba sogs su shes pas gya nom lhar zhen gyi mtshan rtog las skyob par 'gyur ro// //gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rang nyid sgrol ma dkar mor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i dbus drang por/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor leb chags su gnas pa'i steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar tām̐ dkar po/ bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi yi ge bcu pa byed pa'i skabs su/ tām̐ gyi thig le'i steng du oṃ bya lding ba lta bu/ tām̐ gyi 'og 'khor lo'i lte ba'i khong seng du hā/ rtsibs brgyad la yi ge brgyad kho na bsgom pa yin cing*/ sngags sham can bzla ba dang 'brel na/ 'khor lo'i lte bar tām̐/ de'i mthar mdun nas g.yas skor du/ oṃ ma ma āḥyuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru hā/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas brtsam/

tā/ re/ tutā/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā rnams yig ngo nang lta/ thams cad kyang mu tig gi rdog po ltar kha dog dkar po rang 'od 'phro ba/ shin tu mi g.yo ba brtan par gnas pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad de gsal snang thon nges su bsgom mo// //gnyis pa bzlas pa dngos la gsum/ 'gog bzlas/ rdor bzlas/ spro bsdu dang bcas pa'i ngag bzlas so// dang po ni/ rlung rgyu ba rang babs su bzhag thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang yig 'bru rang sgra si li li yod pa la rtse gcig tu dmigs pa ni sems 'gog pa'i sbyor ba'o// //gnyis pa ni/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal bas sdig sgrib bag chags tshe'i bar chad bsal bar bsgom/ 'jam rlung ngam bar rlung tsam la brten te dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe snying ga'i tām̐ las 'od zer spro/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe bsdu/ gnas pa'i tshe tām̐ la sems gtod pa lan brgya phrag la sogs pa bsgom mo// //gsum pa ni/ sgom pa de rnams kyis ngal zhing skyo ba'am/ de dag la gsal snang thob na tshe bcud bsdu bstim gyi dmigs pa dang 'brel ba'i ngag bzlas bya ste/ las mthun nam bo dhi tse'i bgrang phreng byin rlabs byas pa thogs te myur bul la sogs pa'i skyon brgyad spangs nas bzlas pa byas pas/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar pos lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib nad gdon dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba khyad par du srog bcad dang 'tsho ba'i rkyen 'phrog pa sogs tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag 'od zer phyi rol du 'phros/ sa chu me rlung ste 'byung bzhis bsdus pa'i brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten gyi bcud dang dwangs ma thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus/ rang lus thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim pas lus kyi zungs dang sems kyi rten du gyur nas sra brtan rdo rje'i tshe thob par mos/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ tshe'i rig 'dzin/ lha dang drang srong*/

mkhas grub dge bshes/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal/ phyogs skyong sde brgyad sogs g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can rnams kyi tshe bsod kyi bcud gnod pa med par bsdu bstim gong gis 'gre/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum ma lus pa mchod cing thugs dam bskul/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan/ khyad par du 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bstims pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rab tu 'bar/ rdo rje'i tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la bsnyen pa'i skabs yi ge bcu pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi dus spel tshig can gtso bor bzla/ tshe sham can bzla ba'i tshe/ skabs su mos gus kyi shugs kyis spyi bo'i rigs bdag gi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bdud rtsir bsdus te phyag gi lhung bzed nang du zhugs/ zhu zhing khol ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun rang gi tshangs bug nas mar zhugs/ lus thams cad shel bum 'o mas gang ba ltar gyur pa bsgom/ thun mjug tu dbyangs gsal yig brgyas kha skong ba dang*/ ye dhar gyis brtan par byed pa sogs spyi dang mthun par sbyor zhing*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang rung la 'jug go/ //dngos gzhi gnyis pa rdzogs rim la gnyis/ mtshan bcas dang*/ mtshan med do// dang po la'ang gnyis/ srung 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ snying gar tshe phur gdab pa'o// //dang po ni/ bdag bskyed dang 'brel na bzlas pa grub pa'i rjes su 'og tu 'chad pa ltar bsdu rim byas shing zung 'jug gi skur ma ldang ba'i bar dang*/ dus skabs ci bder bsgom na 'di kho na ltar bsgom ste/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis 'khor lo'i gur khang dkar po phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtsibs brgyad/ steng 'og tu gnyis bcas rtsibs bcu rtse mo rim gyis rno zhing g.yas skor du myur ba mi mngon pa tsam du 'khor ba'i lte ba zlum pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la/

rang nyid rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyan cha lugs rigs bdag thugs kar 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa/ steng gi rtsibs kyi sbubs mdor oṃ/ 'og rtsibs su hā/ phyogs mtshams rtsibs rnams kyi rtsa ba sbubs stong gi thad kyi nang du mdun nas g.yas bskor du/ tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā/ zhes pa ste yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dkar po 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba/ yig 'bru 'khor lo dang bcas pa sra ba brtan pa srubs med pa bskal pa'i rlung ser bus kyang mi thar bar bsams la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag 'dir srung 'khor gtso bor byed tshe/ bla ma rnams steng gi cha dang*/ bsrung bya gzhan mchog dman gyi rim pas g.yas g.yon/ dud 'gro sogs rang gi 'og ste thams cad kyang 'khor lo'i gur nang du bsgom zhing*/ 'og gi 'od zer spro bsdu'i skabs rnams su bsrung bya rnams la'ang spro bstim bya dgos so// de nas rang gi thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po zla ba'i zer ma lta bu 'phros/ lus gang*/ sdig sgrib nad gdon bgegs dang bar gcod dus dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal/ slar 'od zer phyir 'phros/ snod bcud kyi dri ma sbyangs/ snod bde ba can dang bcud kyi sems can thams cad sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod cing de dag gi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi lus gang zhing thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang yig 'bru la thim pas zhi ba'i las 'grub cing gzi brjid 'od du 'bar/ 'od lhag ma rnams 'khor lo'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang gi sar zlum por 'khor bas 'od zer dkar po'i gur khang sra brtan srubs med bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi thar ba/ nang gi bar stong thams cad ut+pal sngon po kha bye ma thag pas gang zhing gtams par mos la mnyam par bzhag pa'am/

srung 'khor gtsor bton na sngags yi ge bcu pa bzla'o// des 'gres te/ slar yang 'od zer ser po gser btso ma lta bu 'phros/ lus gang*/ 'chi ba bsal/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang longs spyod snyan grags nyams rtogs shes rab rgyas/ 'od zer phyir 'phro ba sogs nas/ 'od zer ser po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rgyas pa'i las 'grub/ 'od lhag ma 'od gur dkar po'i phyi rol 'dom gang gi sar zlum por 'khor ba'i bar mtshams ut+pal sngon pos gtams par bsgom/ de bzhin tu thams cad la sbyar te/ 'od zer dmar po pad+ma rā ga lta bus brtan g.yo 'khor 'das mkhyen brtse nus gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus/ 'od zer dmar po bstims pas dbang gi las grub cing*/ 'od gur gnyis pa'i phyi rol du 'od dmar po'i gur khang*/ 'od zer lcags kha tho rengs kyi gnam lta bus/ dug lnga dgra bgegs bar chad log 'dren sogs mi mthun phyogs thams cad tshar bcad/ 'od zer sngon po bstims pas drag po'i las 'grub/ 'od gur gsum pa'i phyi rol du 'od sngon po'i gur khang*/ 'od zer ljang gu ma rgad lta bus mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad gcig car bsgrubs/ 'od zer ljang gu bstims pas las sna tshogs 'grub/ 'od gur bzhi pa'i phyi rol du 'od ljang gu'i gur khang*/ 'od zer mchin kha iṇ+d+ra nī la lta bus las dang dngos grub thams cad mi nyams shing brtan par byas/

mthing kha smug zhad can yin gsungs/ 'od zer mchin kha bstims pas byin rlabs dang las 'grub pa rnams brtan cing gang gis kyang gzhom gzhig mi nus par gyur/ 'od gur lnga pa'i phyi rol du 'od mchin kha'i gur khang ste drug rim thams cad kyang gong gi zhi ba'i 'od dkar po'i 'gres sbyar te tshig brjod min gang ltar/ de na re re bzhin rgyas par gsal 'debs la/ mthar de thams cad kyang sgyu ma chu zla mig yor smrig rgyu me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar bden rdzun dang bral ba snang la rang bzhin med pa shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid do// zhes zung 'jug chu zla lta bu bde la mi zhen gsal la mi 'dzin par yun ring du mnyam par bzhag bsgoms pas skyo na/ phyi nang gi sgra skad dang dbugs kyi 'gyu ba thams cad sgrol ma'i sngags kyi rang sgrar rang bzhin gyis grags pa/ de'ang brag ca ltar grags stong bden rdzun dang bral pa'i ngang du shes pa khong glod cing lce rtse g.yo tsam du yi ge bcu pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar 'od gsal du bsdu zhing zung 'jug gi skur ldang ngo*// 'di la sngon gyi yi ge kha cig tu 'od gur bdun rim sogs gsungs kyang da lta drug rim 'di byed pa yin no// //gnyis pa ni/ rang yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba'i sku'i nang stong sang nge ba/ dar dkar gyi gur phub pa'am shel dkar gyi bum pa lta bu'i sku lus kyi nang gi dbus drang por/ srog pa rtsa shel gyi ka ba btsugs pa lta bu/ yar sna spyi bo la cung zad ma reg cing mas sna gsang gnas la cung zad ma reg pa'i yar snar thig le dkar po bde ba'i rang bzhin can dang*/ mar snar thig le dmar po drod kyi rang bzhin can gyis bkag pa/ snying ga'i thad kyi nang dbus su rlung sems kyi ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba zhig brtan par bsgom/ gsal thebs pa na rlung ro bsal/ bum can bzung bas tām̐ las byung ba'i srog gi rlung sngo dmar gyis srog rtsa'i nang 'gro 'ong med par gang bar dmigs te sems bzung ngo*//

//gnyis pa mtshan med rdzogs rim ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ snang srid thams cad 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa rnams 'od du byas te/ srung 'khor la thim/ de gzhal yas khang la thim/ de'ang 'od du zhu rang la thim/ rang nyid gdan dang bcas pa yas nas mar/ mas nas yar 'dus te thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim/ de yig 'bru/ de rnams tām̐ yig de'ang 'a chung ta la/ ta zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ de nā da skra rtse tsam/ de'ang ji phrar mthar mi dmigs par yal te yul yul can gyi rnam pa gang yang ma lus pa dbyings nam mkha' ltar dag pa'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa chen po rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba la mnyam par bzhag ste/ de'ang 'das pa'i rjes mi bcad/ ma 'ongs pa mi sems/ da lta ba la mi rtog 'khor 'das sogs cir yang mi dmigs pa'i gnas lugs de'i ngang du bsgom bya sgom byed sogs dang bral ba'i mi dmigs mi rtog yin min gang du'ang mi 'dzin par grims lhod ran pos rang babs so ma ma bcos lhug par bzhag rnam rtog thol skyes la sna mi bskyil/ 'phro mi mthud/ rbad chod du btang ste so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi rang lugs su bzhag ste bltas pas/ chos rnams kyi gnas lugs gdod nas rnam par dag pa rang bzhin 'od gsal ba gsal stong zung 'jug yod med bden rdzun sogs gnyis snang spros pa gang gis kyang ma gos pa'i dbyings rig dbyer med/ lhan skyes ye shes ci'ang ma yin pa la cir yang 'char ba/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba nam mkha' dag pa'i dkyil ltar dngos gsal kun khyab mtha' dbus mtshan ma kun bral de nyid so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis mthong ba med pa'i tshul du mthong ba la/ ched du mi sgom zhing 'du mi byed par ma bcos rang babs su bzhag pas spros mtshan las 'das pa'i chos nyid gsal bar mthong ba ni lhag mthong*/ de nyid la bsgom bya sgom byed kyi 'dzin stangs dang bral bar rang babs lhun grub tu gnas pa ni zhi gnas/

yang rtog pa rang zhir song nas rang ngo mi rtog par gnas pa'i gnas/ de'i ngo bo spros bral du shes shing thag chod pa'i rtogs pa mngon tu gyur pa lhag mthong*/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel bla na med pa yin par ngo shes par bya ste/ 'di ni chu bo'i rgyun ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor du bya ba'i don po yin no// des na bskyed bzlas thams cad kyi mjug tu sbyor dgos pa gzhir bcas/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su bskyed bzlas dang mnyam gzhag 'dre ba byung na zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor du 'gyur ro// //gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ 'od gsal de'i ngang las skad cig gis chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul du yid bzhin 'khor lo rnam pa thams cad kyi gzugs sku yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgyu ma ltar bden rdzun dang bral ba'i rang bzhin tu gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bos mtshan pas sgo gsum la bar chad 'jug pa'i skabs kyis mi phyed pa/ snang grags rtog gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad don dam par rang bzhin ma grub cing*/ snang cha sgyu ma tsam du rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rang bzhin tu dag pa'i bskyed rim gyi grub mtha' chen po lam du bslang bar bya'o// thun mtshams su'ang ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar/ gtor 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal/ bstod pa/ skor ba/ sāts+tsha gdab pa/ khrus gsol/ 'dod don gsol gdab/ chu sbyin/ srog slu/ sbyin gtong sogs spyi dang bye brag gi dge ba'i bya ba gang lcogs la 'bad cing nyams su blangs pas/ tshe dang blo gros dang nor la sogs pa gnas skabs dang*/ bde stong gi ye shes sogs mthar thug gi dngos grub yid la 'dod pa'i don lo zla tsam gyis 'grub cing*/ tshe rabs kun tu bcom ldan 'das mas rjes su bzung nas rnam kun mchog ldan shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon tu byed par 'gyur ro// tshe khrid 'di kaṃ tshang bka' brgyud la sngon dus shin tu dar srol che'ang*/

bar du dbang lung tsam las khrid rgyun dngos chad cing rje kun mkhyen chen pos rig 'dzin chen po dang*/ des dbus chu lho kha'i sgrub chen zhig las gsan pa brgyud yig ma byung yang*/ paṇa chen byams gling pa'i phyogs nas brgyud pa'i 'phros 'dug gsungs/ de dag smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa'i khrid yig las 'chad nyan mdzad yod par snang yang deng sang de'i rgyun mi 'dug 'on kyang brgyud 'debs su smos pa'i gser phreng rnams byin rlabs brgyud par bar ma chad pa gzhir byas/ bum pa gcig nas gcig tu byo ba ltar don brgyud mtha' dag gtad cing bzung bar ma zad/ rnam pa tsam du'ang rje btsun ma thugs dam gyi lhar mdzad cing zhal gzigs brgyud pa bar ma chad pa rje dhārmā ka ra yan chad smos ma dgos/ bdud 'dul rdo rje dang pad+ma nyin byed yab sras gnyis kas kyang rje btsun ma thugs dam du mdzad pas mngon rtogs sku tshe'i dngos grub khyad 'phags brnyes pa yongs su gsal ba dang*/ rdo rje 'chang pad+ma'i mtshan can thugs sras zung dang bcas pa las kho bo rjes su gnang ba sogs zhus pa yin mod kyi/ khyad par rje bla ma theg mchog bstan 'phel zhabs kyis sgrol dkar lha khrid gnas mdo phyogs nas rtsa ba tsam dang*/ jo nang khrid brgya ltar tshar gcig gsan nas nyams bzhes zla ba drug mdzad 'dug cing*/ de nyid kyis ched du gsol ba ma btab par yang thugs rjes gzigs te kho bo la rjes gnang*/ lung*/ lha khrid zhib rgyas su stsal ba tshig khrid khrigs chags ma'i rgyun bar skabs su chad pa ltar snang yang*/ don gyi ngo bo gong smos ltar ma chad par ma zad/ khrid dang cho ga bsres pa rje dgu pa'i sgrol dkar rgyas pa sogs lung khrid sbrags ma bzhugs bzhin pa dang*/ kho bos kyang de dag dang jo nang khrid brgya'i nang tshan/ khyad par kun gzigs 'jam pa'i dbyangs las ba ri lugs kyi tshe khrid rgyas par nos te nyams len 'dra'ang bgyis nas/

yig cha 'di'ang rje dgu pa'i gsung gi bcud phyung*/ kun mkhyen chen po'i dgongs don gzhir bzhag rje btsun rin po che las brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gis zur brgyan pa yin pas/ phyin chad rang lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyis kyang rang nor la rang brnyas mi byed par khrid srol 'di bskyangs thub pa byung na shin tu gal gnad che ba yod do// //mos pa zhan dang bstan pa'i bab yol bas// khrid srol chu bran sa la thim nye bar// dad dang brtson pas chu rka btsugs zin gyi// chos rjes 'brang rnams bdud rtsir bsten par rigs// grags rjes rgyug rnams sus kyang mi mgu bas// rang gi chos nyid kyis thob zang zing dang*// grags skam phyi sa'i phung por mnog nor bzhin// lto 'gengs spyod pas mi tshe 'phul 'tshal lo// thub bstan sgron me rnams kyi zhabs brtan cing*// lung rtogs dpal rgyas bdag kyang skye kun tu// bla ma yid bzhin 'khor los rjes bzung ste// 'chi med bcud kyis 'gro ba 'tsho byed shog /ces pa 'di'ang thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi bshes gnyen bka' drin gsum ldan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bka' lung zla zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dran pas spro ba'i ku mud cung zad dgod de/ rang la legs par 'dod pa rnams kyi cha rkyen tu/ byams mgon tā'i si tu'i bka' 'bangs karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes bu rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i gdan sa chen po dpal spungs kyi yang dben kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dus tshes bzang por bris pa bstan 'gro la sman par gyur cig /dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
